result.summary: The page is largely well-formed. The main visible anomaly is a '−100%' discount badge on a restaurant card, which looks like a data/content error rather than a plausible promotion. A couple of minor cosmetic points were also noted.

issues.description: The pizza restaurant card displays a '−100%' discount badge, implying the food is completely free. This is almost certainly a data or calculation error (e.g., a free-delivery promo being rendered as a 100% discount) and could mislead users or indicate broken promo logic.
issues.suggestion: Verify the promotion data feeding this badge. If the offer is free delivery, label it '€0 delivery' like the ramen card; otherwise cap/validate discount percentages before rendering.

issues.description: On the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card, '€0 delivery' is shown twice — once as a badge overlay on the image and again in the metadata line below — which is redundant.
issues.suggestion: Show the free-delivery indicator in only one place, or differentiate the two (e.g., badge for promo, metadata for standard fee).

issues.description: Delivery-time pill badges on the 'Fastest near you' cards are inconsistently positioned relative to the card edges (the first card's pill sits lower/closer to the edge than the others).
issues.suggestion: Apply consistent padding/offset for the time badges across all carousel cards.
